output.title: Your monthly books plan

parts.text: Thanks for the details. Here is how we will close your books for last month, and what we need from you first.
Once your bank statement and bills arrive, we will sort the bills, match each one to a bank entry and list any entry that needs your answer. Your plan price is below.
Please send last month's bank statement and photos of your bills, including the card payments.
We can start as soon as the files arrive. This plan is dated
and we will prepare a short report for you to review before anything is final.
